files_modified.behavior_after: Computes Quality Score (TP/(TP+FP+FN)) and Decision Rate ((TP+FP)/(TP+FP+RH+RM)) from phase3 output vs ground truth. CLI: python3 benchmark/compare.py <slug> | --all [--save-baseline]
Ground truth for cartflows — clean (findings: []). Seeded from phase2 output.
Ground truth for pretty-link — clean (findings: []). Seeded from phase2 output.
Ground truth for backwpup — 2 TP findings seeded from phase2 TPs. LOW confidence (pipeline_seeded, not manually verified). Serves as minimum viable benchmark seed.
Baseline created on first run: backwpup QS=1.0/DR=1.0, cartflows QS=null/DR=null, pretty-link QS=null/DR=null. Aggregate QS=1.0, DR=1.0.
Documents benchmark structure, usage, metrics, and accept criteria.

discovered_issues.issue: phase3 validated_findings do not expose vuln_type in a structured field — it is embedded in phase2 findings (not linked). compare.py extracts partial info from check_notes heuristically.
discovered_issues.note: Matching quality degrades for vuln_type check when ground truth has specific types. Workaround: ground truth currently uses 'unknown'. Proper fix: enrich phase3 output to include vuln_type, OR have compare.py load phase2 findings by finding_id to get vuln_type. Consider for Session 1+.

notes: Minimum viable benchmark established. 3 ground truths (2 clean, 1 with low-confidence seeded findings). compare.py passes all test cases. Ready for Session 1 (IR fixes).
